messages:
anya: Opening a focused refresh for the HelloDock quickstart. Plan: add a Go server example, clarify auth for Private deployments (VPC KMS flow), and replace the old Docker Compose with a single-stage Dockerfile. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4214. Need reviewers for Go snippet and Private auth wording.

samir: Love it. One ask: the Go snippet should use the official SDK client idioms, not raw HTTP, so it's easier to map from other languages. If SDK lacks some helpers, show a tiny helper function.

miriam: Editorial: keep the quickstart under 30 lines if possible. Also add a short "What not to do" box: don't commit kube/deploy manifests with keys.

jonah: CI note: our smoke harness doesn't spin up VPC Private stacks, so the Private auth text needs to be explicit about local dev vs deployed environment. Add a callout that local dev uses personal API keys but Private needs KMS-bound tokens and a short link to the Private deployment guide.

anya: Good point. I'll add a short diff table: "Local dev: env var -> REDWOOD_API_KEY" vs "Private: use KMS token exchange (link)". Also including a minimal Go helper that exchanges a KMS-signed token.

miriam: A11y: ensure the copy buttons in the quickstart examples have aria-labels and we provide keyboard copy instructions (Ctrl/Cmd+C focus behavior). I'll add the microcopy.

link-bot: link-checker: found outdated reference -> /deploy/private/setup (404). Suggested replacement: /private/deploy/setup. Added comment on PR.

jonah: CI (pre-merge): added a unit test to verify snippet compile for Go. Right now the example imports github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go@v0.2.0 which doesn't exist in our internal mirror. We should vendor a tiny mock or pin to v0.1.3 for the snippet to pass CI. I'll push a CI-friendly change.

anya: I'll change the import to v0.1.3 in the example and add a short note "pin to the SDK version used in CI". Also switching the Dockerfile to set proper file ownership for /root/.redwood to avoid permission errors in container runs.

samir: Small security nit: add a one-line recommendation to rotate keys and not store long-lived tokens in the repo; link to the secrets rotation guide.

miriam: Once CI compiles the Go snippet and link-bot is happy, I can do a final pass for tone and merge. Tag me in the PR comments.

ci-bot: CI: smoke run queued for PR #4214. Status: lint -> passing, go-compile -> pending, e2e -> pending. Will post results here.

anya: Thanks all  I'll push the example edits now and ping when CI is green. Feel free to drop inline comments on the KMS wording if it reads too heavy.
